title: rbac(v2): add RBAC v2 policy schema + audit logging, KMS integration, and region pin controls
author: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: Enable RBAC v2 (expressive policy schema + migration path), improve audit logging fidelity for compliance, add optional KMS-backed envelope encryption for sensitive metadata, and expose data residency / region pin controls in the account API and console. This change consolidates several Linear tickets into a single rollout-friendly PR: ENG-4123 (RBAC v2 design), ENG-4189 (audit logging schema), ENG-4237 (KMS envelope support), ENG-4271 (region pin API).

Summary of changes (high-level):
- Introduce RBAC v2 policy schema (policy language, conditions, principals). Includes in-service validation and a migration tool that upgrades v1 ACLs to v2 policies.
- Audit logging: structured audit entries with new fields (actor_id, actor_type, resource_path, policy_eval, prev_state, request_id, region). Plumbed into existing audit service and exported to elasticsearch and S3-compatible blob store with configurable retention.
- KMS integration: optional envelope encryption for audit payloads and exported blobs. Uses the existing kms/connector interface and adds KeyRotation metadata.
- Data residency / region pin: new per-account setting region_pin and routing hints; API + console UI + IAM checks to prevent cross-region exports when pinned.
- Backwards compatibility: RBAC v1 ACLs remain supported; migration tool is opt-in and idempotent. Old audit events are interpretable by the new schema.
- Tests, docs, and migration guide included.

Checklist: 
- [x] RBAC v2 schema + validation
- [x] Migration tool with dry-run mode
- [x] Audit schema and persistence changes
- [x] KMS envelope read/write path and rotation metadata
- [x] Region pin API + console UI patch
- [x] Unit & integration tests
- [x] Docs + release notes

Compatibility notes: This is intended to be non-breaking for most customers. Enabling envelope encryption or running the RBAC migration are opt-in. Teams operating in restricted regions should consult the migration guide before enabling exports.

See linked Linear tickets for design docs and threat model (ENG-4123, ENG-4189).

release_notes: Added RBAC v2 policy schema and validator. Opt-in migration tool to upgrade RBAC v1 ACLs. Audit logging now emits structured fields including policy_eval and region. Optional KMS envelope encryption for audit exports. New per-account region_pin setting to enforce data residency. See docs/security/rbac_v2_migration.md for migration steps.
